input.body:
## Summary

Restore the remaining original47 stage and workspace behavior.

```text
stage artwork exceeds bounds → clip without scrolling the fixed origin
primary workspace press → close Enemy Info, retain manual values
secondary press → keep Enemy Info open
```

Stacked on #89.

## Evidence

- **Before:** two mock regressions fail: Enemy Info remains open, and stage-space unexpectedly scrolls to(40,40).
  **After:** native/mock viewer offsets stay(0,0), including an oversized-child scroll attempt; primary dismissal and manual values on reopen pass.
- Formatting, TypeScript,555 rule/parser tests (6,518 assertions), production build and all14 affected native/mock browser cases pass (1.8minutes), without skips. Creator transforms/undo, stats/confirmation/save, dialog text/codes/focus and local viewer routing remain verified. Captures inspected.
- Production changes are the original two overflow:clip assignments and one workspace dismissal call. Decompiled _‑2S invokes _‑Ua when Enemy Stats is open.
- The independent raw-byte audit and production raster probes confirm all21 unique dialog button states contain only EditText and produce no static raster. The omitted cache loop is intentionally inert; labels remain in the existing text layer.
- The68-file audit accounts for original47 runtime recovery once its PR stack lands. Later viewer/profile fixes and controlled original-runtime comparison remain outstanding; full recreation parity is unproven.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores scrollable stage wrappers and persistent Enemy Info on workspace presses.

**Blast Radius:** stage

Shared stage containment and creator panel dismissal. No simulation, profile, generated data or media changes.

## Summary

Recover the standalone local Tank Viewer screen from checkpoint47.

```text
local designs → four cards ↔ retained detail preview
  → sort/page/copy/code/save/delete/select callbacks
  → source fade queues, confirmation layers and local guide
```

Creator routing and persistent help-seen state follow as a separate integration slice.

## Evidence

- **Before:** viewer rules, artwork and widgets had no composed screen.
  **After:** the production component runs in manually clocked fixtures, preserving transferred preview identity, fresh Back cards, signed fade values and deferred deletion.
- Formatting, TypeScript,555 rule/parser tests (6,514 assertions), production build and all8 affected native/mock browser cases pass across focused runs, without skips. Checks include actual preview paint, input dismissal, clipboard/code round trip, local callbacks, guide completion, three ready subscriptions and zero after unmount, with no external requests.

## Summary

Connect the recovered Tank Viewer to creator navigation and local profiles.

```text
Creator Load → Viewer(mode, limits)
  selection → fresh creator(chosen tank)
  Back → current avatar / new empty enemy
  local save/delete → profile
  final guide Next → persist help-seen
```

The paused game viewport, game music and editor replacement context survive the viewer visit.

## Evidence

- **Before:** Load opened the generic code dialog inside the existing creator.
  **After:** the full viewer replaces the creator; public Export snapshots confirm fresh selected designs, avatar restoration and empty enemy Back behavior.
- Formatting, TypeScript,555 rule/parser tests (6,518 assertions), production build and all6 unique native/mock routing/help cases pass across focused runs without skips. Real clipboard copy/delete/code reimport/save persists locally; async read cancellation, details/statistics, paused avatar editing and guide abandonment/completion/reload pass with no external requests or page errors.
- Native/mock screen captures inspected. Decompiled creator Load, Main transition, viewer Back and final-guide/profile serialization paths checked. GameShell matches original47 apart from import ordering; profile migration accepts only Booleantrue and defaults older data tofalse.
- Inherited artwork coverage preserves source random empty starts and checks subsequent recovery without changing production animation.
- Later code/navigation/hover/rejection/save changes, profile unlock/class history, the missing mock right-arrow primitive and controlled original-runtime comparison remain outstanding. Original47 and full game parity remain incomplete.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the generic creator code dialog. The optional persisted help flag can remain in version1 profiles.

**Blast Radius:** navigation

Creator Load/Back/selection, local viewer persistence and first-use help. No simulation, generated data or media changes.
